_doc: Real interview clips for the cold open. Source files live in clips/src/ (not committed). 'in'/'out' are seconds in the source file. 'quote' is the exact words spoken (verified with a Whisper transcript, word timestamps): it drives the captions. 'credit' is shown on screen. Run `python3 prep_clips.py`, then `python3 build_audio.py`. Optional 'video_hold_after' (seconds into the clip) freezes the picture on the last on-camera frame when the source cuts away. Optional 'track_face': {zoom} crops to a smoothed window following the speaker's face, keeping lecture-slide text out of frame; 'blur' (sigma) blurs everything but the speaker.

clips.speaker: Dr. Russell Blaylock
clips._note: He turns toward his slide 0.9 s in; the picture holds his last face-forward frame while his audio continues. Background blurred so slide text isn't readable.
